name: special-cars
gates: node -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync('src/cars.js','utf8').replace(/\/\/.*$/gm,''); const ok=new Set(['#ffd86b','#f2d98d','#ffb02e','#fff4b0']); const bad=(t.match(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/g)||[]).filter(h=>!ok.has(h.toLowerCase())); if(bad.length){console.log('fixed colors in src/cars.js: '+bad.join(', ')+' (paint from the model palette)');process.exit(1)}"
